digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria vocabulary and heading detection
propositions: The codebase carries two equivalent heading names—Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria—for one concept, but all criteria gates pool and apply a single bar regardless of heading, making the split vestigial vocabulary

Success Criteria items written as plain bullets under the SC heading are not counted by _count_ac_items (which resets at the next ##), cannot carry [operator-attested] tags, and are not individually checkable, creating a functional gap that tightens gates

Migrating all criteria text to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, routing indexes, guides, specs, tests, and 106 live store tickets requires expanding detectors to accept both headings first, then collapsing vocabulary, then removing the alias

Plan-review gates apply identical standards to both headings (F1 measurability, G3 child coverage, G7 contract fetch, completion verification), with altitude already carried by routing metadata, so the heading name carries no semantic load

Three sites legitimately retain success-criteria vocabulary outside ticket headings: plan_review_T2.md (pilot metrics phrasing), plan_review_verifier.md and _agentic.md (definition-of-done terminology), and completion.py (heading-sense prose), all excluded from the collapse scope
Post-migration audits found zero remaining SC headings in the live store (106 migrated, 8 prose mentions preserved as backticked text) and 100% grep-sweep compliance within documented exclusions
